upcoming.title: AI and the Climate Crisis: A Critical Look at Challenges and Opportunities
upcoming.description: Join us for the first TSI & McGill Physics Public Talk of the academic year! Professor Alex Hernandez-Garcia from the Université de Montréal and Mila kicks off the series with a talk on climate change and artificial intelligence, taking a critical look at both the challenges and the opportunities AI brings to the climate crisis.

past.title: 24hrs of Science - From Planets to Particles: An Exploration Mini-Fair
past.location: Rutherford Building (3600 Rue University) - McGill University
past.description: Drop in for hands-on activities and demos about gravity, life on other planets, energy, volcanoes, and more. Weather permitting, telescopes will also be set up for solar observing. Activities are geared towards kids ages 5-12, with younger and older siblings and parents welcome.

past.title: Anna McPherson Public Lecture - Gravitational-Wave Astronomy: The Sounds of Silence from the Dark Universe
past.speaker: Alessandra Buonanno, Director at the Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics
past.description: A public lecture on how gravitational waves opened a new window into extreme environments in the universe, revealing the nature of black holes and neutron stars while testing Einstein's theory of general relativity.

past.title: TSI & Physics Public Talk - Is artificial intelligence going to transform our understanding of the universe?
past.speaker: Laurence Perreault-Levasseur, Canada Research Chair in Artificial Intelligence and Computational Cosmology
past.description: A discussion of how upcoming surveys and telescopes will generate unprecedented volumes of cosmological data, and how machine learning tools can help overcome computational challenges in next-generation sky surveys.

past.title: TSI Special Public Talk - The Mystery of Dark Matter in the Universe
past.time: 7:00 PM - 8:00 PM (Public Talk); 8:00 PM - 8:45 PM (Book Signing)
past.speaker: Dr. Katherine Freese, author of The Cosmic Cocktail
past.description: A public overview of dark matter evidence, candidate particles including axions and WIMPs, and why cosmologists believe the field may be approaching an epochal discovery.

past.title: TSI & Physics Public Talk - Designing the Sustainable Aircraft of Tomorrow
past.description: A talk on conceptual aircraft design, systems engineering, multidisciplinary optimization, and AI-driven tools for sustainable aviation.

past.title: TSI & Physics Public Talk - How Nuclear Physics Can Help in the Fight Against Cancer
past.speaker: Cornelia Hoehr
past.description: A public lecture on how nuclear physics, particle accelerators, detectors, medical isotopes, and radiotherapy research support cancer diagnosis and treatment.

past.title: Exploring Exoplanets: A Panel Discussion
past.speaker: Jonathan Gagne and Casey Brinkman
past.description: A two-talk panel on free-floating planets, complex atmospheres, and how exoplanets mirror the compositions of their host stars, followed by a Q&A on current exoplanet research.

past.title: TSI & Physics Public Talk - Digital Skies for Ancient Contexts: Reconstructing Ramesside Star Clocks with Python
past.speaker: J. Luna Zagorac
past.description: A talk on using Python and planetarium software to reconstruct ancient Egyptian skies and investigate how Ramesside Star Clocks were created.

past.title: TSI & Physics Public Talk - Arctic Climate Change: What Is Happening and Why It Matters
past.speaker: Bruno Tremblay
past.description: A closer look at rapid Arctic warming, sea ice decline, and what these changes mean for Arctic wildlife, communities, and people far from the North.

past.title: TSI & Physics Public Talk - The Flight of the HELIX: Measuring the Galaxy from 40 km Above Greenland
past.speaker: David Hanna
past.description: An introduction to cosmic rays and the HELIX balloon-borne particle detector, with a focus on its first flight from Kiruna, Sweden to Ellesmere Island in Nunavut.
